title: The Resort
content: My 'MallWorld' experience was a lucid dream I had about a year and a half ago. Had it a few times for a few months, then not since. It was a resort type place, part of it was on a huge lake or lagoon that had these mini jetski things you could take out on the water. Near the main resort was a large covered area where you could hang out in the water, there were a few swim up bars and even a spot where you could pull up one of the jetskis to grab a drink. There were wide spaces of deep water between the bars to accommodate both swimmers and the vehicles. Past that, you could go out onto more open water and even into a race course type set up. Inside the resort was a large arcade, filled with traditional arcade games, along with like ski ball, etc. Multiple floors of these with open gyms off to the side for basketball, boxing, and other exercise and competitions. The walls in the arcade area were purple with old school 80's designs on them and the carpet was like typical arcade carpet. Thin, a little dirty, and more than a little sticky from spilled soda and careless kids making messes. There was also a burger and pizza type eatery there. The rooms and suites are all beautiful like marble accented and way nicer than the arcade area. I don't remember them as much as the arcade and lake. Anyone else ever had a dream visit to a place like this? Am I just nuts? Should I get investors to build this place?
